paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Metzia 47a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.47a.12), raising an objection to Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The Bavli has Rav Huna of Diskarta questioning Rava. [Heilprin cites the same passage](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1010&lang=en) and writes Rabbah.
